shared_elements: carved stone relief on a vertical surface
horizontal register divided by a raised band
row of repeated motifs along a band
row of small repeated animal heads/forms at the top
justification: Both are stone reliefs organised into stacked horizontal registers separated by plain bands, with a row of small repeated forms across the top and profile animals and upright figures below. The manner of carving is quite different: A is coarse, shallow and schematic with irregular outlines on weathered tan stone, while B is crisp, deeply modelled and highly regularised with detailed drapery, wheels and ornamental rosette borders.
